$comment: BC Transit's Fraser Valley system (Agassiz-Harrison, Central Fraser Valley, Chilliwack, Hope), plus the route that reaches Lougheed, which is shown as an overlay in Metro Vancouver. Areas start at 122.5° W: Abbotsford and Mission use this primary live feed, while Langley remains in Metro Vancouver.
name: Fraser Valley
